capabilities: Display file modification times in the File Explorer
Show YAML property values as badges next to note titles
Compose custom labels from templates with {name}, {path}, {property}, {date}, {time} placeholders
Filter which notes show details based on property conditions
Adapt layout to sidebar width by aligning right or wrapping below titles
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README with configuration examples; also installable via BRAT; README states it never modifies notes or sends network requests.
intentEvidence: Enhances Obsidian's built-in File Explorer directly without replacing your familiar file browser
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer shows only note names, so metadata like modification dates or property values requires opening notes or other views.
summary: File explorer decorator that shows modification times, note property values, and custom template text next to each note in Obsidian's native file tree.
